function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian entrepreneur, philanthropist, and former politician known primarily for his work in the technology and education sectors. He co‑founded **ReddyTech**, a software development firm that grew into one of India’s leading IT services companies before he sold it in the early 2000s. After stepping away from business, Reddy entered politics, serving as a member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly for two terms (2008–2018) where he focused on rural development and digital literacy initiatives.

Beyond his corporate and political careers, Reddy has been active in philanthropy. He established the **Reddy Foundation** in 2015, which funds scholarships for underprivileged students and supports community health projects across rural Karnataka. His foundation also runs a network of free coding bootcamps aimed at bridging the digital divide.

In recent years, Reddy has returned to the tech world as an advisor to several start‑ups in Bangalore, focusing on AI and fintech solutions. He remains a respected figure in both the business and civic communities for his commitment to social impact and sustainable development.
